name: Raschke Turtle Soup: 20-day extreme false break (3+ days old) re-entry
author: Linda Bradford Raschke (via RoboForex)
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
entry_long: Daily 20-day range. Wait until the 20-day low (or high) is broken, where the prior extreme was set at least 3 days earlier. When price returns inside the range by 10 points from the old extreme, buy (for a low break) or sell (for a high break) on H1.
entry_short: 20-day high broken (old high >= 3 days old), then price returns 10 points below the old high -> sell.
exit: Hold 2-3 days; exit via trailing stop of 50-70 points (or manual trailing behind correction highs/lows).
stop_loss: Beyond the new extreme made by the false break, then trailing 50-70 points
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Point values are instrument-specific; convert for crypto.
